description: Source code implementing VDSO support for kernel symbol lookup, including initialization, symbol lookup, and CPU identification functions within the absl debugging internal namespace.

classes.name: VDSOSupport
classes.description: Class representing kernel VDSO support, including symbol lookup, initialization, and CPU identification.

methods.name: VDSOSupport
methods.description: Constructor initializing VDSO support object, setting up the image and base address.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the VDSO base address by reading auxiliary vectors or /proc/self/auxv.

methods.name: SetBase
methods.description: Sets the VDSO base address manually.

methods.name: LookupSymbol
methods.description: Looks up a symbol in the VDSO image by name, version, and type.

methods.name: GetCPUViaSyscall
methods.description: Performs a syscall to get CPU ID, fallback if not supported.

methods.name: InitAndGetCPU
methods.description: Ensures initialization and retrieves CPU ID using the available method.

methods.name: GetCPU
methods.description: Fast function to get current CPU ID, callable from low-level code.
